list.expr:
(min by (job,instance, os_description) (min_over_time(timestamp(target_info{os_description!="", job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"})[$__range:1m] @ end()))
unless on (job,instance, os_description) last_over_time(target_info{os_description!="", job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[1d] @ start())
and on (job,instance) last_over_time(target_info{os_description!="", job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[1d] @ start())
) * 1000 > $__from < $__to
list.name: OS or kernel change

targets.expr:
100 * (1 - avg by (job,instance) (sum by (job,instance, cpu) (system_cpu_utilization_ratio{state=~"idle|wait", job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"})))
or
100 * (1 - avg by (job,instance) (sum by (job,instance, cpu) (system_cpu_utilization{state=~"idle|wait", job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"})))
